name: Cognitio Labs
long_description:
CoAsync by Cognitio Labs is the AI back office for product quality compliance teams.

We help mission-critical food manufacturers automate repetitive, document-intensive workflows.

We started with Certificates of Analysis (COAs), one of the many workflows quality teams manage before products can ship. Today, this work is still performed manually across PDFs, emails, spreadsheets, and disconnected ERP systems. 

Other documents we help quality teams respond to 24x7 include supplier audit questionnaires, production schedules, lab reports & changes in product specifications and quality records.

CoAsync automates the workflow by:

Reading supplier documents
Extracting laboratory data
Validating product specifications
Applying compliance requirements
Drafting compliant COAs
Organizing audit-ready documentation

Results from one of our initial deployments with a mid-market food processor:

85% less QA administrative work
4× more COAs processed per shift
1-2 hours saved per document
New product onboarding in under one day

COAs are just the beginning. Our vision is to build the AI back office for product quality and compliance across regulated industries by automating the many document-intensive workflows manufacturers manage every day.

Backed by Y Combinator and leading investors. Founder Diva Avaya Sharma has presented example AI workflows for product quality and compliance through the World Economic Forum Centre for Advanced Manufacturing and Supply Chains' SmartStart initiative and at the International Telecommunication Union's AI for Good Global Summit, organized in partnership with the United Nations.

Know a company shipping food & product urgently? Help them get started with their own document workflows at https://cognitioiq.com

CoAsync by Cognitio Labs, the AI back office for product quality teams.

Certificates of Analysis are one of the sources of documentation clogging food and consumer product shipments today. Every day, millions of dollars of product sit waiting to ship because paperwork isn't ready to certify it is safe.

Before food can leave a facility, quality teams review supplier documents, lab reports, product specs, and regulatory requirements to produce a COA, the document certifying a product is safe, meets quality standards, and complies with destination-country rules. That still happens across PDFs, emails, spreadsheets, and disconnected ERPs, and a single COA can take hours.

CoAsync ingests supplier documents, extracts lab data, validates specifications, applies country-specific compliance requirements, and drafts audit-ready COAs, keeping quality teams in control at every step.

launches.title: Cognitio Labs – Real-time food traceability for safety and compliance
launches.tagline: Automating real-time food traceability for FDA compliance
launches.body:
[Cognitio Labs](https://cognitioiq.com) is an applied AI research lab building real-time compliance infrastructure for regulated supply chains, serving as the first line of defense against recalls and regulatory failure.

View our launch video at: [**https://youtu.be/iFD6vxaS0eY**](https://youtu.be/iFD6vxaS0eY)

When a food contamination event happens, time is everything. If traceability takes days instead of hours, entire product categories get destroyed, brands lose trust, and recalls cost $10M to $100M+.

Yet today, most operators still rely on spreadsheets, PDFs, and manual logs. Traceability data is fragmented across facilities, systems, and partners, and critical events like temperature, handling, and lot transformations are not automatically captured or standardized. As a result, generating accurate, regulator-ready records is slow, manual, and error-prone.

**Why now:** The FDA’s [FSMA 204 rule](https://www.fda.gov/food/food-safety-modernization-act-fsma/fsma-final-rule-requirements-additional-traceability-records-certain-foods) requires companies to produce standardized, lot-level digital traceability records within 24 hours by 2028, impacting over 60,000 U.S. food facilities. The regulatory bar is rising, but the infrastructure to meet it requires improvement.

We are building that infrastructure.

Our system uses sensors and AI to automatically capture key events such as temperature, humidity, handling, and lot-level movements across production, storage, and transit. We convert fragmented operational data into standardized, FSMA 204-compliant traceability records and generate regulator-ready reports in real time.

Compliance is generated as operations happen, not after.

This becomes the first line of defense by enabling faster recalls, reducing spoilage, eliminating manual compliance work, and protecting contracts, insurance coverage, and brand equity. Avoiding even one major recall can save $10 million to over $100 million.

Cognitio Labs was founded by [Diva Avaya Sharma](https://www.linkedin.com/in/diva-sharma/), a Stanford-trained technologist who previously built a patented remote patient monitoring system integrating sensors and machine learning in regulated healthcare environments, recognized by global development institutions and national innovation programs.

We are starting with food and expanding into other regulated, high-risk supply chains.

Learn more at [**cognitioiq.com**](http://cognitioiq.com).

Follow our Linkedin Page [**here**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/110755112/)**.**
